requirements.requirement: The system must transform each raw measure value into a normalized_score using a defined deterministic formula per measure.
The system must apply a predefined weight to each normalized_score to compute contribution_to_final_score.
The system must ensure that the same input raw_value always produces the same normalized_score (deterministic behavior).
The system must support multiple normalization strategies (e.g., min-max, z-score) selectable per measure.
The system must constrain normalized_score values within a defined range (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100) per measure specification.
The system must calculate contribution_to_final_score as normalized_score multiplied by weight.
The system must ensure that the sum of all contribution_to_final_score values equals the final composite score within a defined tolerance.
The system must handle missing raw_value inputs by assigning a default normalized_score or excluding the measure based on configuration.
The system must raise a controlled error when a normalization formula is undefined for a given measure_id.
The system must raise a controlled error when weight configuration is missing or invalid for a measure.
The system must log intermediate calculation steps (raw_value, normalized_score, weight, contribution) for each measure for auditability.
The system must process a batch of measures in a single request and return computed normalized_score and contribution for each.
The system must ensure floating point precision is consistent and rounded to a defined number of decimal places.
The system must prevent negative or out-of-range weights from being applied in contribution calculations.
The system must allow configuration-driven updates to normalization formulas and weights without code changes.
